common.footer: Production deploys require human approval. Do not publish to production automatically.

home.eyebrow: Stage 3 · guardian links and team lifecycle
home.headline: Welcome to the Club management system
home.lead: Sign in with a phone SMS one-time code. Parents can request a link to an existing player; admins approve. Admins can revoke approved links, deactivate or delete empty squads, and manage players and coaches.
home.sampleBody: Current language: English. Use the language switcher above to see Traditional Chinese or Japanese strings.
home.stackSupabase: Supabase phone OTP, profiles, multi-role, org master data, guardian links, and RLS
home.stackPwa: PWA: web app manifest and basic meta
home.envConfigured: Public Supabase variables are present. Sign-in talks to this project (anon key only).
home.envMissing: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is not set. The homepage still previews, but sign-in cannot work.

auth.title: Sign in with your phone
auth.lead: We send a one-time SMS code. On first successful sign-in we create a profile and assign the default parent role.
auth.phoneHint: Taiwan numbers can be entered in local 09… format; we convert them to E.164. Example: 0912 345 678.
auth.codeSent: If SMS is configured, a code was sent. Enter it before it expires.
auth.codeSentTo: The code will be sent to {phone}
auth.smsBlocked: SMS could not be sent. Enable Phone Auth in the Supabase Dashboard and configure an SMS provider (for example Twilio). You can still enter a code to test the error path, but you cannot complete login until SMS works.

errors.notConfigured: Public Supabase environment variables are missing, so sign-in is unavailable.
errors.smsNotConfigured: SMS is not configured or the message failed to send.
errors.rateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait and try again.
errors.invalidOtp: That code is not valid. You are not signed in.
errors.expiredOtp: That code has expired. You are not signed in. Request a new one.

app.title: Club dashboard
app.welcome: Parents can request a link to a child and withdraw a pending request. Admins manage teams, players, coaches, and binding approval or revoke. Coaches can open assigned rosters. Other operations features are still later stages.
app.profileMissing: Missing (sign in again, or confirm the database migration was applied)
app.noDashboardRole: This account does not have a parent, coach, or admin role.
app.playerNote: The player role is reserved for later stages. There is no player login experience yet.

children.title: Players / children
children.body: Request a link to an existing player. After an admin approves, they appear here.

courses.title: Courses
courses.body: Course enrollment and schedules are not available yet.

squads.title: Assigned roster
squads.body: Read-only list of players on teams assigned to you.

teams.title: Teams
teams.body: Create and edit training squads and age bands.

players.title: Players
players.body: Create player records with English given and family names, at least one of Traditional Chinese or Japanese, date of birth, team, and jersey number.

coaches.title: Coaches
coaches.body: Link an existing signed-in profile, then assign teams.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: Attendance tracking is not available yet.

assessments.title: Assessments
assessments.body: Ability assessments are not available yet.

members.title: Members
members.body: Parents request a link to an existing player; admins approve on the bindings page. Promote extra admins in the Supabase Dashboard.

bindings.title: Guardian bindings
bindings.body: Approve, reject, or revoke parent requests to link to a player.

adminNote.title: Role promotion
adminNote.body: There is no in-app backdoor. Add an admin row for the user in the Dashboard user_roles table. Linking a coach also grants the coach role.

access.deniedBodyAdmin: Admin pages are limited to club admins. Coaches can open the roster; parents can request a child link from My children.
access.deniedBodyRoster: The roster is limited to assigned coaches and admins. Parents without those roles stay on the dashboard.

admin.title: Admin
admin.lead: Organization master data for this club. No real personal data is seeded.
admin.teamsBody: Create training squads with an age band and active/inactive status. Deactivate, reactivate, or delete an empty team from this list.
admin.playersBody: Each player needs an English given name and family name, at least one of Traditional Chinese or Japanese, a date of birth, a team, and a jersey number unique on that team.
admin.coachesBody: The person must sign in once so a profile exists. Then you link them here and assign teams. That also grants the coach role.
admin.bindingsBody: Parents search for an existing player with team + jersey or birth date + name, then request a link. Approve, reject, or revoke an approved link here. Pending, rejected, and revoked parents cannot read that child’s record.
admin.teamsEmptyBody: Create the first squad. Nothing is preloaded.
admin.playersEmptyBody: Create a team first, then add players. Do not enter real personal data on shared staging unless you intend to.
admin.coachesEmptyBody: Ask the coach to sign in once, then link their profile.
admin.playersNeedTeamBody: A player needs a team and a jersey number unique on that team.
admin.teamRosterEmptyBody: Create a player and assign this squad plus a jersey number.
admin.bindingsEmptyBody: When a parent requests a link, it shows up here for approval.
admin.teamLifecycleBody: Deactivating hides this squad from parent link search; existing memberships stay. Permanent delete is allowed only when there are no memberships and no coach assignments.
admin.deleteTeamConfirm: Permanently delete “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
admin.deleteBlockedActive: This team still has {count} active memberships. End or inactivate those memberships first, or deactivate the team instead.
admin.deleteBlockedMemberships: This team still has {count} membership rows. Remove them before deleting, or deactivate the team instead.
admin.deleteBlockedCoaches: This team still has {count} coach assignments. Unassign coaches first, or deactivate the team instead.

roster.title: Roster
roster.lead: Players on teams assigned to you. This list is read-only.
roster.emptyBody: When an admin assigns you to a team that has players, they will show up here.

org.nameCjkHint: Fill Traditional Chinese and/or Japanese. At least one of the two is required.
org.seasonStartLabel: Season start used for this calculation: {date} (cutover every 15 August, Asia/Taipei)
org.jerseyHint: 1–99. Unique on this team; the same number may be used on another team.
org.ageBandMismatch: The player’s suggested age band does not match this team’s band. You can still save.
org.linkCoachHint: The user must already exist (they should sign in once). Linking creates a coach record and grants the coach role. Then assign teams.
org.noLinkableProfiles: There are no other profiles to link. The person needs to sign in with phone OTP once, then reload this page.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.notConfigured: Public Supabase environment variables are missing.
errors.invalidName: Enter both the English given name and family name.
errors.missingCjkName: Enter a Traditional Chinese name, a Japanese name, or both.
errors.invalidBirthDate: Enter a valid date of birth.
errors.futureBirthDate: Date of birth cannot be in the future.
errors.invalidJersey: Jersey number must be an integer from 1 to 99.
errors.jerseyTaken: That jersey number is already used on this team.
errors.incompleteSearch: Search with team and jersey number, or with date of birth and at least two characters of a name.
errors.searchNameTooShort: Name fragment must be at least two characters.
errors.noPlayerMatch: No player matched those details. Check the team, jersey, date of birth, or name.
errors.invalidRelation: Choose how you relate to this player.
errors.linkAlreadyOpen: You already have a pending or approved link to this player.
errors.cannotCancelLink: You can only withdraw your own pending request.
errors.cannotRevokeApproved: Approved links can only be revoked by an admin.
errors.cannotRevokeLink: Only an approved link can be revoked.
errors.teamHasActiveMemberships: This team still has active memberships. End or inactivate them first, or deactivate the team instead.
errors.teamHasMemberships: This team still has membership rows. Remove them before deleting, or deactivate the team instead.
errors.teamHasCoachAssignments: This team still has coach assignments. Unassign coaches first, or deactivate the team instead.
errors.generic: Could not save. Please try again.

children.title: My children
children.lead: Request a link to a player the club already created. An admin must approve before you can see their details here. Later stages will use this link so a parent can register for courses or mark attendance.
children.emptyChildrenBody: After an admin approves a request, the player’s name, date of birth, team, and jersey appear here.
children.emptyRequestsBody: Use the form below. You will not see a full club roster — only a match if your search is specific enough.
children.requestLead: Use exact team and jersey, or date of birth plus part of a name. Both together narrows the result further.
children.searchHint: The app does not list every player. Fill one complete search (team + jersey, or birth date + name), or fill both.
children.searchIdentityHint: Name needs at least two characters. It is matched against English given/family and Traditional Chinese or Japanese names.
children.confirmHint: Check this is your child, then submit. Until an admin approves, you cannot open their record from My children.
children.parentNoteHint: Optional. For example how the club can recognise you. Do not paste extra contact details the club does not already have.
children.noMatchDetails: Player details are shown only while this link is approved.
